info.title: Annette Cards API
info.description: Annette Cards server: API, sync and the embedded PWA

400.description: `validation_failed`: days outside 1–90 or note too long

409.description: `invite_used`: used invites stay as a record

get.summary:
The clip's bytes. `X-Audio-Source` says where it came from; `X-Audio-Attribution` (percent-encoded UTF-8) names
the author and license of a recording, so a cached clip carries its attribution offline.

200.description: The clip, cached for a year

X-Audio-Attribution.description: Percent-encoded author and license, when known

post.summary: Signs in with email and password and sets the `ac_session` cookie.

200.description: Signed in; the response sets the session cookie

429.description: `rate_limited`: more than 10 attempts a minute from this address

post.summary: Signs out: revokes the current session and clears the cookie.
Revokes all sessions of the user except the current one.

get.summary: The signed-in user. Also renews the cookie's lifetime, which keeps the sliding session alive in the browser.

post.summary: Changes the password and signs out all other sessions.
Creates an account with an invite code and signs it in (sets the `ac_session` cookie like login).

200.description: Registered and signed in; the response sets the session cookie

400.description: `invite_invalid` (unknown or used code), `invite_expired`, `password_too_short` or `validation_failed` (email, or display name empty or over 100 characters)

429.description: `rate_limited`: more than 10 attempts a minute from this address

post.summary:
Generates or finds audio for the card and attaches it (`cards.audio_id`); every device gets the change on its
next pull.

400.description: `validation_failed`, `unsupported_language` (no voice for the deck's language) or `not_implemented` (`commons`, until it is available)

404.description: `not_found`: no such card (or it is deleted)

409.description: `tts_disabled`: the server has no TTS provider

delete.summary: Removes the audio from the card. The clip stays downloadable, so devices that cached it keep working.

204.description: Removed (or the card had no audio)

get.summary: The whole account as a backup file (architecture.md §6.5), the same format as the app's local backup.

200.description: Backup JSON, sent as the attachment `annette-export-YYYY-MM-DD.json` (UTC date)

get.summary: Liveness check including a database ping.

post.summary: Restores a backup into an account that has no decks. Rows get new ids and sync to every device.

400.description: `invalid_format` (not a backup, bad rows or references) or `unsupported_version` (written by a newer app)

get.summary: Server version and enabled optional features.

Downloads the user's rows changed after `cursor`, in `server_seq` order; repeat with the returned cursor while
`has_more`.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Return rows with `server_seq` greater than this (default 0: everything).

post.summary: Uploads local changes: each row is applied, skipped (the server's row wins last-write-wins) or rejected.

200.description: Every row is listed in `applied`, `skipped` or `rejected`

400.description: `validation_failed`: malformed body or more than 500 rows

get.summary: Counts of the account's decks and cards, for the first sign-in choice (S-03).

200.description: Decks and cards that are not deleted

voice.description: TTS voice name (e.g. `en-GB-RyanNeural`); default: the voice of the deck's language.

attribution.description: Author and license of a recording; `null` for generated audio.

audio_id.description: The new `cards.audio_id`; the clip is at `GET /api/audio/{audio_id}`.

AudioSource.description: Where the clip should come from.

Backup.description: A full backup (architecture.md §6.5), the same format as the client's local backup.

app_version.description: Version of the app (here: the server) that wrote the backup.

settings.description: The fields of the settings document that were set (§5.5).

CardStateDto.description: FSRS state of one card direction, stored as the client computed it (the server never reschedules).

Changes.description: Rows of every synced entity. Missing arrays count as empty.

note.description: Who the invite is for, e.g. "Anna"; at most 200 characters.

Direction.description: One study direction of a card.

Directions.description: Which directions of a deck are studied.

EntityIds.description: Row ids per entity; card states as `"{card_id}:{direction}"`, settings as a flag.

code.description: Stable snake_case error code, never user-facing text.

details.description: Optional machine-readable details (e.g. which field is invalid).

Features.description: Optional server features; the client hides the UI of disabled ones.

InviteSummary.description: An invite as the admin list shows it.

used_by_email.description: Email of the account registered with this invite.

device_label.description: Shown in the list of sessions, e.g. "iPhone Safari".

changes.description: Changed rows, soft-deleted ones included, each entity in `server_seq` order.

cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to the next pull.

applied.description: Written on the server (new or newer than the stored row).

server_time.description: Server clock, for the client's clock-skew warning.

skipped.description: Not written because the server's row wins last-write-wins (or is identical); the client gets it on pull.

invite_code.description: The 12-character code from the invite link; letter case does not matter.

Rejected.description: A row the server refused; the client keeps it out of the outbox and logs it.

id.description: Row id (`"{card_id}:{direction}"` for card states, `"settings"` for settings).

ReviewLogDto.description: One answer. Append-only: after the first push only `deleted_at` (undo) may change.

practice.description: Answered in practice mode (UC-16, decision D2).

state_before.description: The card state before the answer (JSON object with the `CardStateDto` scheduling fields).

SettingsDto.description: The settings document (architecture.md §5.5) with its LWW stamp. `data` holds only the fields set by the user.

SummaryResponse.description: Account data counts for the first sign-in choice (S-03, decision D6).

cards.description: Cards that are not deleted, in decks that are not deleted.

SyncEntity.description: The synced entities, as named in payloads.
